info.name: Platform API v1
info.description:
STALE — predates the RestfulApiResponse envelope migration: bodied 2xx responses are now wrapped in { code, message, data, traceId }; the payload field names are unchanged. 204s stay bodyless. Regenerate against a running admin service.
Gateway base {{baseUrl}} = http://localhost:8080/api/admin. Send Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} after login. Create user, login, and refresh are open.
